hardware_pages.notes: Section 087100 runs 389-412; sets start p406 under '3.x D. Hardware Sets:' and end p412 (Group 15) with 'END OF SECTION 08 71 00'. 390/397 are Part 1/Part 2 prose (submittals, continuous hinges).

has_header_row: Yes, repeated under every set: 'QTY DESCRIPTION CATALOG NUMBER FINISH MFR' (unit EA/SET column is unlabeled, sits between QTY and DESCRIPTION).
multi_page_sets: none seen; every group fits on one page (page breaks fall between groups).
not_used_style: none seen. Groups 14/15 are 'ALL HARDWARE BY OVERHEAD DOOR MFG 626 B/O' and '1 EA ALL HARDWARE BY GATE MFG' (by-others placeholders, not NOT USED).
set_level_lines: Door numbers listed as a grid directly under the header with no label: '8A 8B 23 26 27 28 29 30 31 32 34 35 36 37 38', '41.1BF 41.2BF ... 41.8OH'
'Provide each SGL door(s) with the following:' / 'Provide each PR door(s)...' / 'Provide each SL door(s)...' / 'Provide each RU door(s)...'
Trailing notes in caps: 'BALANCE OF DOOR HARDWARE TO BE SUPPLIED BY ALUMINUM SUPPLIER', 'CARD READER BY SECURITY SUB DIV.28 TO RELEASE DEVICE FOR ACCESS', 'OPENING TO COMPLY WITH LEVEL E TESTING'
collision_examples: Finish 'A' / 'AA' (aluminum, on ZER thresholds/meeting stile) and 'BK'/'BR'/'GRY' are short alpha finish codes; they are always in the FINISH column immediately before the 3-letter MFR, so column position decides. No PE/NO/AL collisions seen.
quirks: Door numbers printed as a multi-column grid between header and 'Provide each ...' line, no 'Doors:' label - easy to mistake set header digits for door numbers (e.g. 'Hardware Group No. 02 40' in text = group 02, door 40).
Catalog-cut-sheet link icon column between CATALOG and FINISH (renders as a glyph token in text).

Wrapped description cells: token text emits the wrap continuation AFTER finish/mfr, e.g. 'PRIVACY LOCK W/ ND40S RHO OS-OCC 626 SCH OUTSIDE INDICATOR' and 'ELEC FIRE EXIT RX-QEL-WS-9927-L-F-06 24 626 VON HARDWARE VDC' (catalog wrap 'VDC' also trails).
Wrapped finish cell: '630-' / '316' on two lines (p406 90 DEG OFFSET PULL) - text shows '630- IVE 316'.
Missing mfr: Group 13 'BOTTOM FLOOR GUIDE C-GUIDE SLDING BARN DOOR FLOOR GUIDE 630' has no MFR.
Missing qty: Group 14 'EA ALL HARDWARE BY OVERHEAD DOOR MFG 626 B/O'.
Unit 'SET' used ('1 SET MEETING STILE 328AA-S AA ZER').
Several groups per page; page footer '#2024814 DOOR HARDWARE 08 71 00 - 18 08/29/25' plus logo.
notes_for_extractor: Layout is clean Allegion/Comsense style, but wrapped description/catalog cells come out of reading order after the finish/mfr tokens, so line reconstruction must use bbox rows rather than token order. Door-number grids under the header need to be separated from the set number; some lines lack qty or mfr.
